title: API tokens
intro: Tokens let scripts and other tools use Floorbit's API without signing in, like a scoreboard, a Discord bot or your own dashboard. Each token has a role, like an account, and can be limited to reading. Tokens can never manage accounts or other tokens.
name: Name
nameHelp: What uses it, so you know what breaks when you revoke it.
roleHelp: The token can do what this role can.
expiresHelp: Leave empty for a token that never expires.
readOnlyHelp: The token can read, but not change anything.
madeHelp: Copy it now: Floorbit keeps only a fingerprint and can't show it again. Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".
revokeQuestion: Revoke "{{name}}"? Whatever uses it stops working right away.
docs: The API is described in docs/api.md.
